situations.title: SIRS/qSOFA 기초 사정
situations.tagline: I've been feeling feverish and my heart's been racing — is that bad?
situations.brief: 활력 이상 조합을 확인해 조기 패혈증 위험을 선별하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me check your temperature, heart rate, and breathing together.
A few of these being off can be an early warning sign.
Do you have any pain, cough, or burning when you urinate?

situations.title: 감염 의심+활력 이상
situations.tagline: I've had a fever and now I'm breathing fast and feel really off.
situations.brief: 발열·빈맥·빈호흡 조합을 사정하고 초기 대응을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Fever with a fast heart rate and breathing needs a closer look.
We'll check your blood and look for the source of infection.
Where do you feel most unwell — your chest, belly, or elsewhere?

situations.title: 배양 채취 설명
situations.tagline: Why are you taking so much blood before giving me the antibiotic?
situations.brief: 항생제 전 혈액배양 채취의 이유를 알기 쉽게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We draw blood cultures before antibiotics to find the exact bug.
That helps us pick the best medicine for your infection.
It only delays the antibiotic by a few minutes.
goals: 항생제 전 배양 채취의 이유를 설명한다

situations.title: 정맥로·수액 시작 설명
situations.tagline: Do I really need all these fluids? My arm already feels cold from it.
situations.brief: 초기 소생을 위한 정맥로 확보와 수액의 목적을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: These fluids help support your blood pressure and blood flow.
The cold feeling in your arm is normal and will pass.
We're giving them quickly because your body needs the support.

situations.title: 소변량 모니터링 설명
situations.tagline: Why do I need this catheter and why are you measuring my urine?
situations.brief: 소변량이 관류 지표임을 설명하고 모니터링의 목적을 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Your urine output tells us how well your organs are getting blood.
Measuring it helps us know if the fluids are working.
It's an important sign we watch closely in cases like yours.

situations.title: 패혈증 1시간 번들
situations.tagline: I feel like I'm burning up and completely wiped out.
situations.brief: 배양·항생제·수액·젖산을 1시간 내 시행하며 각 단계를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We're moving fast — cultures, antibiotics, fluids, and a lactate test.
This lactate level tells us how stressed your body is.
We're giving fluids now to support your blood pressure.

situations.title: 젖산 상승 해석
situations.tagline: The nurse said my lactate is high — what does that mean for me?
situations.brief: 젖산의 의미를 설명하고 재측정과 관류 반응 감시를 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: A high lactate means your tissues aren't getting enough oxygen.
After fluids, we'll recheck it to see if it's improving.
It's one of the main things we track to guide your treatment.

situations.title: 노인 비전형 패혈증
situations.tagline: Dad's not himself — he's confused and cold, but he says he feels fine.
situations.brief: 저체온·섬망 등 비전형 발현을 인지하고 사정을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: In older adults, sepsis can show up as confusion or a low temperature.
The fact that he's cold and confused is why we're taking this seriously.
Has he had any recent infection, catheter, or wound?

situations.title: 요로성 패혈증
situations.tagline: My back and side hurt and I've had burning pee, and now I'm shaking with fever.
situations.brief: 감염원 통제와 폐쇄 시 감압 필요성을 사정·설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The flank pain with a urine infection can lead to a serious infection.
We'll check if there's a blockage that needs to be drained.
We're starting fluids and antibiotics now.

situations.title: 폐렴성 패혈증
situations.tagline: My pneumonia's gotten worse — I can barely breathe and I feel like I'm shutting down.
situations.brief: 호흡부전 진행을 감시하며 패혈증 소생을 병행 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Your pneumonia has spread to your whole body, so we're acting fast.
We're giving oxygen, fluids, and antibiotics right now.
I'm watching your breathing closely and will support it if needed.

situations.title: 수액반응성 평가
situations.tagline: You've given me so much fluid — am I getting any better?
situations.brief: 소생 후 재사정으로 수액반응성을 평가하고 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: After the fluids, I'm rechecking your pressure and how you're breathing.
This tells us if your body needs more fluid or a different support.
Let me know if you start to feel short of breath.

situations.title: 면역저하 잠복 패혈증
situations.tagline: I'm on immune-suppressing meds — I just feel a little off, no real fever.
situations.brief: 미묘한 조기 신호를 놓치지 않고 사정하며 대응을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: On immune-suppressing medicine, even mild symptoms can be serious.
We won't wait for a high fever — we'll check thoroughly now.
We're drawing cultures and watching you closely.

situations.title: 카테터 관련 균혈증
situations.tagline: I get dialysis through this line, and now I get chills every time it's used.
situations.brief: 라인 관련 균혈증을 의심하고 라인 제거 판단을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Chills when your line is used can mean the line is infected.
We'll draw cultures from the line and from your arm.
We may need to remove the line to clear the infection.

situations.title: 산모 패혈증
situations.tagline: I'm 32 weeks pregnant with a fever and terrible belly pain — please help my baby.
situations.brief: 임신 생리를 고려하며 태아 감시와 패혈증 소생을 병행하세요.
keyPhrases: We're treating your infection and watching your baby at the same time.
We're starting fluids and antibiotics that are safe in pregnancy.
We're monitoring your baby's heartbeat continuously.

situations.title: 패혈증 언어장벽 위중
situations.tagline: She's very hot, very weak, and her family is frightened.
situations.brief: 통역과 가족을 병행 활용해 위중한 패혈증 소생을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Through the interpreter — we believe she has a serious infection.
We're giving fluids and antibiotics urgently, and I'll explain each step.
Please ask her where she feels pain and when this started.

situations.title: 패혈성 쇼크 승압제
situations.tagline: His pressure won't come up no matter how much fluid you give.
situations.brief: 수액 불응 쇼크에 승압제와 중심라인을 준비하며 SBAR로 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Fluid-refractory shock — we need to start norepinephrine now.
Prepare for central access to run the pressor safely.
Septic shock, MAP under sixty-five after two liters — I need the physician at bedside.

situations.title: 다장기부전 진행
situations.tagline: Her kidneys and liver numbers are all getting worse.
situations.brief: 신·간·응고 악화를 사정하고 가족에게 상태를 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The infection is now affecting several of her organs.
We're supporting her kidneys, liver, and blood clotting as best we can.
This is very serious, and the team is doing everything possible.

situations.title: 젖산 지속상승 위기
situations.tagline: My hands and feet are going cold and blotchy…
situations.brief: 지속 상승하는 젖산과 소생 실패를 인지하고 긴급 호출하세요.
keyPhrases: Your lactate is still climbing, which tells me you need more support.
The mottling of your skin means your circulation is struggling.
I'm escalating this now and getting the physician back in immediately.
goals: 젖산 지속 상승과 소생 실패를 인지한다

situations.title: 쇼크 급변 삽관
situations.tagline: I… can't… keep breathing on my own…
situations.brief: 호흡부전 진행을 인지하고 기도확보를 준비하며 팀을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Your breathing is tiring out, so we're going to help you with a tube.
We're preparing everything to keep you safe during this.
I'll be right here — try to stay calm and breathe with the oxygen.

situations.title: 패혈증 심정지 전조
situations.tagline: His pressure's collapsing and his rate is crashing — arrest is close.
situations.brief: 관류 붕괴와 심정지 전조를 인지하고 소생 준비를 지휘하세요.
keyPhrases: His pressure is collapsing and the rate is dropping — arrest is imminent.
Get the crash cart here and pads on now.
Keep the pressor running and prepare for compressions if he loses pulse.

situations.title: 중증 패혈증 ICU 이송
situations.tagline: Transferring a septic shock patient to the ICU — need to hand off the bundle.
situations.brief: 번들 이행 상태와 승압 정보를 정리해 ICU 팀에 SBAR로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Septic shock, source is a urinary infection, bundle completed within the hour.
He's on norepinephrine at eight, MAP holding at sixty-six.
Last lactate was four, down from six after resuscitation.
